title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Training Note — Recomputed and Printed Minimums for Steady Payers
content:
**Which minimum does the minimum-satisfying payment start from?** On a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account, the minimum-satisfying payment is worked from the minimum used. It is set by the account's payment record and the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership:

| Payment lines credited to the account in the last 12 months | The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | Minimum used |
|---|---|---|
| At least 10 | ProBuild Silver, Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite | The lower of the recomputed minimum and the printed minimum |
| At least 10 | No Silver or higher membership (ProBuild Member or Bronze, or no active membership) | The recomputed minimum |
| Fewer than 10 | Any | The printed minimum on the statement |

The 12 months are whole calendar months counted back from the payment date; payment lines are the payment lines credited to the account in that window.

**What is the recomputed minimum?** The recomputed minimum is the adjusted statement balance in full when it is below the preferred minimum floor, and otherwise the greater of the preferred minimum floor and the preferred minimum percentage of the adjusted statement balance, that percentage figure rounded to the nearest cent.

**Worked cases (hypothetical: printed minimum 120.00; adjusted statement balance 3200.00, preferred floor 25.00, preferred percentage 2.00)**

The recomputed minimum is the greater of 25.00 and 2.00 percent of 3200.00 (64.00), that is 64.00.

| Payment lines in 12 months | Membership | Minimum used |
|---|---|---|
| 12 | ProBuild Gold | 64.00 (lower of 64.00 and 120.00) |
| 10 | ProBuild Bronze | 64.00 |
| 9 | ProBuild Gold | 120.00 |

With an adjusted statement balance of 18.40 and a preferred floor of 25.00, the balance is below the floor and the recomputed minimum is 18.40.
